remarks: The Home You’ll Love, the Opportunity You’ve Been Waiting For! Welcome to 13041 Corrigan Ave, a beautifully maintained, move-in-ready 3-bedroom, 2-bath pool home offering comfort, thoughtful upgrades, and the best of Southern California living. The updated kitchen features two-year-old cabinetry, granite countertops, and stainless-steel appliances, complemented by fresh interior paint, hardwood flooring, new bedroom carpeting, double-pane windows, and copper plumbing throughout. Additional highlights include an indoor laundry room, tankless water heater, newer roof, and fully paid solar panels for added energy efficiency and long-term value.
